commands_run.purpose: Proves-too-much / silent-coincidence construction: a maximally broken Level2.frob that does NOT crash
commands_run.patch: Level2.frob(x) -> return x unchanged (identity), instead of (L1.conj(A), L1.mul(L1.conj(B), self.s))

results.interpretation: 17160 = 6105 + 11055 exactly: the bug folds every four_cycle point into 'identity' (a no-op Frobenius always looks like the identity permutation), yet the CLOSURE of the surviving generators (two reflection classes + central element) still reaches the full order-8 D4, because two reflections from different conjugacy classes already generate D4 by composition. group_order==U is therefore satisfiable by this broken code with FOUR_CYCLE COMPLETELY ABSENT.

commands_run.exoneration_check: Independently tallied the REAL run's N1_k1_exhaustive.jsonl (both runs, all 44521 rows) directly (not the Executor's summary): identity=6105 (not 17160), four_cycle=11055 (present, not absent) -- exactly matches EXP-MONO-4c7479's own committed reference histogram (independently grepped from experiments/EXP-MONO-4c7479/runs/RUN-MONO-4c7479-20260830/raw-result.json, confirmed identity:6105 genuinely present there, not something invented for this contract). The real run does NOT exhibit the identity-bug's fingerprint at k=1, and four_cycle counts at k=2,3,4 (from raw sampled logs, ~24-26% of 10000, matching D4's expected 2/8 class density) show the same is true at k>=2.

confidence_note_on_N1: HIGH confidence that N1 genuinely did not drop in this run. This rests on: (1) independent recomputation of R_k=8 at every k, both runs, from raw permutation data using from-scratch closure code; (2) a full hand re-derivation of the D4 element-order signature (1 identity + 5 order-2 + 2 order-4) matching exactly; (3) ruling out, from raw per-point data (not summary trust), the specific silent-failure mode that a broken Level2 Frobenius could plausibly produce (four_cycle present with structurally-correct density at every k, exactly matching an external sibling-experiment reference at k=1); (4) confirming the coupon-collector false-negative risk is astronomically small, so this is not a sampling-adequacy question at all. Residual, disclosed uncertainty: the pre-run bug-catch narrative itself has no artifact trail (named as Objection 1, a process gap), and the labelling control's raw data was not retained (Objection 4).
